title: Jarvis: my personal AI assistant (Upwork demo)
note: Recreated UI with sample projects and names, for privacy. Every flow shown is a real Jarvis feature.

title: Jarvis
my personal AI assistant
beats.say: This is Jarvis, the personal AI assistant I built and use every day. I talk to it on Telegram, by text, by voice, or on a call.

title: A request
becomes a ticket
beats.say: When I ask for something, Jarvis turns it into a ticket on the right project's board, and queues it.

title: A worker
does the job
beats.say: A Claude Code worker picks it up, makes the change on its own branch, runs the tests, and merges it when they pass.

title: Status
any time
beats.say: I can ask how it is going at any moment, and get the live progress.

title: Done
with the result
beats.say: When it's finished, I get a short update with the result and a link.

title: Long-term
memory
beats.say: It remembers our past conversations, so I never have to repeat myself. Decisions from last week are one question away.

title: Drafts first,
sends on my OK
beats.say: Anything that goes out in my name, it drafts first, and sends only after I approve it.

title: Works on
my Mac
beats.say: It can also work on my Mac: find a file, open an app, or take a screenshot, and send me the result.

title: For your portal
Outlook + Graph
beats.say: For your portal, the same approach connects to Outlook through Microsoft Graph: email, calendar and research, private to you.
